topic: Data adjustments for JCD Brazil task
summary_markdown:
The conversation revolves around data processing and required adjustments for the JCD Brazil client project (DOOH-1217). Initially, [me] spent two days creating two tabs out of three. It was later determined that a large portion of the added data (~1.1B sessions) from the original ~2.3B is unnecessary for the client, and adjustments are required to remove this excess.

[me] expressed concern regarding scope creep and potential over-processing, noting that processing each facility takes 1-2 hours. [p1] later clarified verbally that everything was fine, resolving the initial misunderstanding.
decisions: Adjustments must be made to remove ~1.1B unnecessary sessions from the JCD Brazil data.
action_items: [me] needs confirmation/coordination with someone regarding the necessary changes for the JCD Brazil task.
